full_page.content:
c. 1945
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Autograph by Father Solanus on lower right corner of a picture taken at the office, St. Bonaventures, Detroit. Written c. 1945.
Only in Heaven can we be satisfied as being fully and really con- verted. Therefore - including the above, poor Fr. Solanus - pray for the conversion of sinners, - and that God send laborers into His Harvest.
(s) Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
